name: switchtender-ui-e2e
description: Real-browser tests for the SwitchTender web UI, driven by Playwright. The smoke suite renders and navigates the seeded read-only demo; the interactive suite launches a run and creates objects against a writable serve instance and checks the change persisted. The assess suite drops exports on the browser assessment page, served from the site directory, and checks it reads them in its worker and fetches nothing once loaded. Together they complement the dependency-free node --test suite in ../assets/jstest, which drives the same production JS against a simulated DOM: that suite proves the logic and wiring, and these prove the pages render, click through, and mutate in a real browser engine.

scripts.test: npm run build:bin && npm run build:assess && playwright test
scripts.build:assess: cd ../../.. && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o site/assess/assess.wasm ./cmd/assessweb && cp -f "$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js" site/assess/wasm_exec.js
